subject: science
concept: Understanding stars, including that the sun is a star and other stars are much farther away
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Earth's Place in the Universe) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student compares the apparent brightness of a near light source versus a far one to model why stars look small
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a description of the sun to its identity as a nearby star
exercise.abstract: Student explains why the sun looks so much bigger and brighter than other stars

misconception_flags: believes the sun is fundamentally different from other stars rather than just much closer

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
